answer: Sybil resistance follows from an EigenTrust-style trust matrix whose reciprocity-weighted links propagate reputation only through credible peers, while exponential temporal decay halves stale evidence at each fixed half-life. A fresh identity starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality and no trusted incoming paths, so it cannot pass consensus by multiplying accounts; it must earn reputation through sustained honest service. A karst inlet feeding a grove is no shortcut: isolated sybils cannot manufacture trusted flow.
